 Follow Crystal Palace vs Newcastle United live score, confirmed lineups, match stats, standings & minute-by-minute updates in Premier League on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Caio Lopes Patricio Updated October 25, 2026, 10:27 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 10:27 AM ET 25' 10:27 AM ET 2 minutes ago The match continues with few exciting moments, with Newcastle and Crystal Palace struggling to create attacking plays. The game remains concentrated in midfield, with tight marking and little creativity, while neither team manages to create many chances in front of goal.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 Key moments
 10:01 AM ET 0' Kick-off 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 19' 10:21 AM ET 8 minutes ago The match remains balanced, with Newcastle and Crystal Palace battling for possession and struggling to create clear goal-scoring opportunities. Despite some attempts at quick counter-attacks, both teams are hampered by the opposing defense and rarely manage to create dangerous chances.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 12' 10:15 AM ET 14 minutes ago Mateta receives the through ball up front, creates space and shoots across goal, aiming for the far corner of the Newcastle goal. The Crystal Palace striker tries to capitalize on the opportunity to open the scoring, but the play ends without a goal.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 7' 10:08 AM ET 20 minutes ago Crystal Palace threaten again on a quick counter-attack. McNeil leads the attack and finds Kamada with a through ball. The midfielder's shot is poor, but the ball almost falls to Mateta inside the box, creating another opportunity for the visitors.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 3' 10:05 AM ET 24 minutes ago Crystal Palace almost opened the scoring! After a free-kick, the Newcastle defense struggled to clear the ball, and players from both teams contested the loose ball inside the area. In the ensuing scramble, a shot deflected off Dan Burn, but goalkeeper Horníček managed to make the save and prevented the home side from scoring.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 0' 10:01 AM ET 27 minutes ago The first half of the match between Newcastle and Crystal Palace begins! Before the initial whistle, players from both teams knelt on the field in an act of combating racism and supporting racial equality. The ball then rolled for the Premier League duel.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 9:56 AM ET 33 minutes ago Importance of victory for Newcastle
 Newcastle seeks to secure three points to improve its position in the Premier League and gain consistency in the competition. Playing in front of its home crowd, the team aims to take advantage of the home advantage to overcome Crystal Palace and get closer to the top of the table. A victory would also be important to strengthen the team's confidence and continue the work throughout the season.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 9:56 AM ET 33 minutes ago Importance of victory for Crystal Palace
 Crystal Palace enters the field aiming to secure important points away from home and improve their position in the Premier League table. Against Newcastle, the team intends to demonstrate defensive consistency and take advantage of opportunities in attack to surprise the home team. A positive result could also boost the team in the remainder of the championship and increase confidence for upcoming matches.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 9:51 AM ET 37 minutes ago Refereeing
 The match will be officiated by Paul Tierney (ENG), assisted by Simon Long (ENG) and Mark Stevens (ENG). The fourth official will be Matt Donohue (ENG), while Darren England (ENG) will be in charge of the video assistant referee (VAR).

 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 9:01 AM ET an hour ago Key player for Newcastle
 Forward Harvey Barnes is one of Newcastle's main attacking options for the match. In the 2026/27 season, the player has three goals and two assists in nine games across all competitions.
 In the Premier League, Barnes played seven games, scored one goal and provided two assists, totaling 630 minutes on the pitch. In the English League Cup, the forward scored twice in two matches, with 135 minutes played.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 8:50 AM ET 2 hours ago Key player for Crystal Palace
 Midfielder Adam Wharton is an important piece in organizing Crystal Palace's midfield. Valued at 75 million euros, the player stands out for the quality of his passing and his ability to contribute to building plays.
 In the 2026/27 season, Wharton has three assists in 11 matches across all competitions. In the Premier League, he played seven games and provided one assist, accumulating 617 minutes on the pitch. In the Europa League, he participated in three matches and provided two assists.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 8:20 AM ET 2 hours ago Head-to-head history
 Newcastle holds the advantage in the overall record against Crystal Palace. In 58 matches between the teams, the Magpies have won 31 times, while the Eagles have won 14 times. The other 13 games ended in a draw.
 At Selhurst Park, the balance is greater, although Newcastle also holds an advantage: ten wins for the visitors, against nine wins for Crystal Palace, in 26 matches.
 In the English league, the clubs have faced each other 38 times, with 17 wins for Newcastle, 11 for Crystal Palace and ten draws.
 In the most recent encounter, Crystal Palace won 2-1 and will try to repeat the result in front of their home crowd.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago How Newcastle is doing
 Newcastle is currently 11th in the Premier League with eight points and arrives under pressure after losing 1-0 to Aston Villa in their last match.
 The Magpies are on a two-game losing streak and haven't won in two games. Despite the negative results, the attacking sector shows signs of consistency: the team has scored in their last four away games.
 However, their defensive performance has been a problem, as Newcastle has conceded goals in their last four matches. The team has also accumulated two consecutive away defeats, a streak they will try to break at Selhurst Park.
 Against the Eagles, Newcastle will seek recovery to gain points and get closer to the top positions in the table. To do this, they will need to balance their attacking output with greater defensive security.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago How Crystal Palace is doing
 Crystal Palace arrives for the match in 14th place in the Premier League, with seven points. The team seeks to get back to winning ways after a run of three games without a victory.
 Despite their inconsistent form, the Eagles have positive home form. The team has scored in their last five home games and won their two most recent matches in front of their fans, demonstrating their ability to capitalize on home advantage.
 On the other hand, their defense has conceded goals in their last four matches, an aspect that could worry the coaching staff against a Newcastle side that has been scoring frequently.
 In their previous match, Crystal Palace drew 2-2 with Besiktas in the Europa League. Now, the team will try to translate their offensive performance into a positive result in the Premier League and climb the table.
 Live updates by Caio Lopes Patricio
 7:45 AM ET 3 hours ago Match Stadium
 The match will be played at Selhurst Park, a stadium located in London, England, and home of Crystal Palace .
 Opened in 1924, the stadium has a capacity of approximately 25,000 spectators and is known for the intense atmosphere created by the Eagles' fans.
